title: Twin-Court Treatise of the Unmasking
summary: A treatise of two courts that unmask a foe in turn and then rule on what lies beneath so that the ruling lands as one stroke.

title: The Clear Basin Mastery
summary: A mastery of gathering clear qi like water in a basin until nothing false can float in it and pouring it out over the rim.

title: Hawk-Eyed Canon of the Naked Fact
summary: A canon of the hawk's sight that finds the bare fact under every show and drops on it from the height of the field.

title: The Wind-Sworn Reckoning of Plain Speech
summary: A sworn reckoning of speech carried on the wind so that every plain word reaches the foe and every false word dies in the air.

title: Manual of the Unwalled Truth Sense
summary: A manual of a sense of truth thrown open over a wide ground that no lie or hidden thing can cross unmarked.

title: Oath of the Unerring Bearing
summary: A sworn manual of keeping one exact bearing through every illusion and storm and of striking where the bearing ends.
